info.name: RideLink
info.description:
End-to-end workflows for RideLink, with assertions on every request.

Run the folders in order: later folders depend on ids and tokens the earlier ones store in the environment.

Start all four services first (account, driver, fare-payment, ride) with MySQL and RabbitMQ running.

newman run postman/RideLink.postman_collection.json -e postman/RideLink.local.postman_environment.json

item.name: 05 Completion and payment
item.description: Polls until the event-driven final fare exists, pays by card, fetches the receipt, and confirms the ride's own payment status caught up via payment.succeeded.

request.description: Returns 404 PAYMENT_NOT_READY until the ride.completed event has been consumed. This request retries itself up to ten times - the visible face of eventual consistency, and the reason the code is distinct from a plain NOT_FOUND.

exec: // Brief pause between polls so the retries span a sensible window.
